purpose: Prevents overnight chain multiplication. Each cadence/watchdog cycle reads this BEFORE arming anything. If a fire time here is still in the future, a chain is already armed -- run the cycle and do NOT arm another. Only arm when the relevant slot is in the past, then update it here and commit.
why: Several chains were firing simultaneously around 05:00-05:35. The cause is structural: a one-shot send_later chain re-arms itself, so any cycle that arms 'just in case' permanently doubles the chain. list_triggers, update_trigger and delete_trigger all require an approval the owner cannot give while asleep, so pruning afterwards is impossible -- the only lever is not arming in the first place.

agentProposal: OWNER PROPOSAL 2026-08-26, ASSESSED, NOT STARTED - awaiting owner go-ahead plus an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret and a spend decision. Per-filing agent extraction of notes-derived fields, one pass per filing (not one agent per field - the notes are one contiguous region). RECOMMENDED SCOPE: match, vesting, Roth/after-tax = yes (all of today's v81-v85 defects were linguistic). Provider = NO (Sch C structured data, already 93.3%). Fund lineup = NO (a table; 116k holdings arithmetic-checked against Sch H assets). Expense ratios = NOT IN THE FILING AT ALL - that is a fund->ticker->published-ER lookup job, not extraction. TWO DESIGN CRUXES: (1) every value must carry a VERBATIM QUOTE, verified programmatically to appear in the document and to contain the value - hallucination then degrades to a dropped row instead of a false claim; (2) agent output must be a CACHED per-ack artifact, never recomputed on a PARSER_VERSION bump. STAGE 1 = oracle pass on 500 filings regex already answers, to get a measured agreement rate before trusting it with the backlog.
